data.content: IMPLEMENTATION PLAN for Phase 1 agent recovery/compaction/tool redirection hardening. Boundary: finish Phase 1 before starting collapse/docs/security phases; preserve pre-existing dirty compaction files until reviewed; use additive/backwards-compatible error fields unless Codex+Claude concur otherwise. Child work: hive-flow-3d64 = failure/error/tool-call redirection; hive-flow-4c59 = microcompaction/autocompaction parity; hive-flow-30bc = live self-audit/native tool usability; hive-flow-3ca6 = final gates/commit/push after agreement. Lane 1A redirection: audit v3/@hive-flow/cli/src/mcp-client.ts, src/mcp-tools/agent-tools.ts, and src/mcp-tools/queen-tools.ts for every returned error/failure path including missing bridge, missing owner session/client kind, provider key/preflight/model/concurrency errors, invalid task/result ids, process exit without result, parse failures, queen spawn/dispatch/collect failures, and permission deny/redirect paths. Standardize structured guidance such as code, retryable, redirection, nextActions, owner, and artifact hints while preserving existing human-readable messages. Centralize helper logic so future errors inherit recovery directions. Lane 1B compaction: audit .claude/helpers/context-persistence-hook.mjs, .claude/helpers/compaction-recovery.cjs, compact-now helper surfaces, and related tests. Treat the existing uncommitted direct /compact measurement block as pre-existing WIP; get Claude concurrence before keeping/modifying/removing it. Confirm true full compaction arms recovery and summary/ack safeguards, microcompaction and detached/headless boundaries do not over-arm recovery, direct /compact floor is deterministic, and autocompaction guidance matches Codex CLI expectations. Lane 1C live self-audit/tools: Claude should run broad Hive Flow provider-agent verification with queen-led/read-only workers and generous timeouts; Codex should run conservative Codex-owned agent canaries that prove projectRoot, ownerClientKind=codex, task execution, task_result, and actionable failures. Use native subagents only if Hive Flow cannot complete a task and record the reason. Lane 1D tests/gates: add focused regression/property coverage around redirection output shape, permission/tool-error recovery guidance, compaction-recovery nonce/evidence/summary rules, compact floor measurement failure, and bridge/provider failure cases. Run focused node/vitest tests first, then relevant bats/private/security/type/pre-commit gates. Do not commit/push until Codex and Claude both agree the implementation and live runs are green. Known risk: literal any failure is best enforced by centralized helpers plus representative coverage; any nontrivial design decision or disagreement must be routed to Claude for concurrence before code changes.
